newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT UP 3.8 PCT Y/Y IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT UP 3.8 PCT Y/Y IN APRIL.

text.p: Greek industrial production rose provisionally 3.8 percent year-on-year in April from 1.7 percent in March, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.
Industrial output was up 1.9 percent in the period January-April 1997 compared to the same period in 1996, it said.
Manufacturing output increased a provisional 3.1 percent year-on-year in April from 0.6 percent in March. It was up 0.9 percent in the first four months of 1997 compared to January-April 1996.
